desc:
⚡ **SYSTEM: AWAKENED** ⚡
*Incremental Game*

**You've been chosen by the System.** Will you rise to the top or remain at the bottom?

Start as a weak nobody and become the strongest fighter! Train your stats, collect powerful cards, build your crew, and conquer territories!

━━━ 🃏 **HOW TO PLAY** ━━━

💪 **TRAIN** — Increase your Strength, Speed, Endurance, and more!

🎴 **ROLL CARDS** — Discover rare cards and unlock powerful abilities!

⭐ **AWAKEN** — Break your limits and reach higher ranks!

👊 **FIGHT** — Challenge powerful bosses and prove your strength!

👥 **BUILD YOUR CREW** — Recruit fighters and make your crew unstoppable!

🌎 **CONQUER** — Take over territories and rise to the top!

🤝 **PLAY WITH FRIENDS** — Progress together and become stronger!

━━━ ❗ **THE SYSTEM** ━━━

Every quest makes you stronger.

Every card changes your future.

Every battle brings you closer to the top.

**How far will you go?**

🔥 Inspired by Questism

👍 Like the game for more
